title: Resident Evil Village PC DRM: Cracked Code Really Does Run Better - Confirmed
summary: Digital Foundry investigates why Resident Evil Village on PC runs worse with Capcom's Denuvo DRM than a cracked version. They benchmark and confirm performance and frame-pacing differences.
why: Cited as the evidence that Denuvo DRM measurably hurts game performance.

quote.text: The folks at Digital Foundry did a phenomenal job breaking down the specifics, as usual.
